summary: mF International Ltd filed a Form 6-K to disclose receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice for late filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for FY2025. The notice cites non-compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1); the company has until July 17, 2026 to submit a compliance plan, with a possible extension to November 11, 2026. No terms, price, or special-situation event such as a merger or restructuring are involved. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure with no immediate impact on trading. Watch for the company's compliance plan submission.
